about.heading: 1st-year CS (AI/ML), shipping in public.

short: I'm a 1st-year Computer Science (AI/ML) undergraduate in Pune, building practical AI workflows, terminal CLIs and full-stack web apps — and shipping all of it publicly on GitHub.
medium: I'm a 1st-year Computer Science (AI/ML) undergraduate based in Pune. Instead of keeping coursework in private folders, I build and ship public tools on GitHub — from hackathon code generators like HackStack to terminal CLIs and Python game loops.
I'm looking for software engineering and AI/ML internships, Google Summer of Code (GSoC) projects, and hackathon teams where I can own a feature end to end.
detailed: I'm a 1st-year Computer Science (AI/ML) undergraduate in Pune, India, and I learn by shipping. My work sits where applied AI developer tooling meets clean TypeScript architecture: HackStack turns a two-to-three-sentence hackathon idea into a schema-validated full-stack codebase, pitch deck and demo script, while Slate Vision CLI is an interactive terminal playground with its own verification suite.

Alongside those I shipped Snugg, a mobile-first TypeScript and PostgreSQL app on Vercel, wrote Python arcade games from scratch to practise game loops and collision maths, and had my first external pull request merged — a working 3-pane workstation dashboard for Blue10.1.

Right now I'm focused on deepening my AI/ML fundamentals and contributing to open source, with the aim of a GSoC contributor project and a summer internship where I can own features end to end. Everything I build stays public, so the commit history is the CV.
